{"tool":"write","path":"tests/test_export_csv.py","content":"import unittest

from reports.export import export_csv


class TestExportCsv(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_basic_and_order(self):
        rows = [{"b": 1, "a": 2, "c": 3}, {"a": "x", "c": "y"}]
        result = export_csv(rows, ["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(result, 'a,b\r\n2,1\r\nx,\r\n')

    def test_quoting_and_doubling(self):
        rows = [{"a": 'he said "hi"', "b": "line1\r\nline2", "c": "x,y"}]
        result = export_csv(rows, ["a", "b", "c"])
        self.assertEqual(
            result,
            'a,b,c\r\n"he said ""hi""","line1\r\nline2","x,y"\r\n',
        )

    def test_none_missing_and_str_conversion(self):
        rows = [{"a": None, "b": 0, "c": 1.5}]
        result = export_csv(rows, ["a", "b", "c", "d"])
        self.assertEqual(result, "a,b,c,d\r\n,0,1.5,\r\n")

    def test_ignores_unselected(self):
        rows = [{"a": 1, "z": "ignore me"}]
        self.assertEqual(export_csv(rows, ["a"]), "a\r\n1\r\n")

    def test_one_shot_generators(self):
        rows = iter([{"a": i} for i in range(3)])
        cols = (c for c in ["a"])
        self.assertEqual(export_csv(rows, cols), "a\r\n0\r\n1\r\n2\r\n")

    def test_empty_rows_and_columns(self):
        self.assertEqual(export_csv([], ["a", "b"]), "a,b\r\n")
        self.assertEqual(export_csv([], []), "")
        self.assertEqual(export_csv([{"a": 1}], []), "")
        self.assertEqual(export_csv([], (c for c in ["a"])), "a\r\n")

    def test_duplicate_columns_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            export_csv([], ["a", "a"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            export_csv([{"a": 1}], iter(["a", "a"]))

    def test_non_string_columns_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            export_csv([], ["a", 1])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            export_csv([], [None])

    def test_unicode_preserved(self):
        rows = [{"a": "caf\u00e9 \u4e2d\u6587"}]
        self.assertEqual(export_csv(rows, ["a"]), "a\r\ncaf\u00e9 \u4e2d\u6587\r\n")

    def test_inputs_not_mutated(self):
        rows = [{"b": 1, "a": 2}]
        cols = ["a", "b"]
        export_csv(rows, cols)
        self.assertEqual(rows, [{"b": 1, "a": 2}])
        self.assertEqual(cols, ["a", "b"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
"}
